criterion: The legal or responsible operator is named.
rationale: A participant needs to know who accepts money and carries obligations.
evidence_prompt: Record the operator name, registration or legal status and service address.

criterion: A monitored contact and escalation route are provided.
rationale: Questions and urgent issues need more than a social profile.
evidence_prompt: Test the ordinary and urgent contact routes.

criterion: Application status and decision dates are current.
rationale: An open label can become misleading when dates have passed or a cohort has started.
evidence_prompt: Capture the page, timestamp and stated decision timeline.

criterion: Exact arrival, departure and program dates are stated.
rationale: Travel and accommodation decisions depend on unambiguous dates and time zones.
evidence_prompt: Record dates, check-in windows and time zone.

criterion: The city and venue status are confirmed.
rationale: A concept image or provisional city is not a confirmed accommodation booking.
evidence_prompt: Request the address or a documented disclosure of when it will be supplied.

criterion: Room allocation, occupancy and accessibility are described.
rationale: Shared-room assumptions materially affect fit, privacy and cost.
evidence_prompt: Record bed type, room sharing, bathrooms, stairs and accessibility constraints.

criterion: Capacity and minimum viable cohort are disclosed.
rationale: A residency can change or cancel if too few or too many people join.
evidence_prompt: Record maximum capacity, minimum cohort and the consequence if unmet.

criterion: The total price, currency and taxes are stated.
rationale: A headline price may omit taxes, deposits or mandatory extras.
evidence_prompt: Request an itemized total in the payment currency.

criterion: Included and excluded services are itemized.
rationale: Accommodation, food, transport, workspace and activities should not be inferred.
evidence_prompt: Create an inclusion and exclusion list.

criterion: Payment recipient, schedule and method are verifiable.
rationale: The payee should match the responsible operator or a disclosed agent.
evidence_prompt: Record invoice issuer, payee, due dates and payment protection.

criterion: Cancellation, refund and organiser-cancellation terms are supplied before payment.
rationale: A participant needs to understand losses under each cancellation scenario.
evidence_prompt: Save the terms version accepted at payment.

criterion: Visa and work-authorisation responsibility is explicit.
rationale: A residency invitation does not determine immigration or work rights.
evidence_prompt: Check current official authority guidance for the participant’s nationality and activity.

criterion: Insurance expectations and exclusions are explicit.
rationale: Travel, health, equipment and cancellation risks may require different cover.
evidence_prompt: Record required cover and who bears uninsured costs.

criterion: Emergency contacts and evacuation procedures exist.
rationale: Shared accommodation in an unfamiliar place needs a practical incident plan.
evidence_prompt: Request emergency numbers, exits, assembly point and hospital route.

criterion: Health, accessibility and accommodation needs have a private route.
rationale: Participants need a way to discuss needs without public disclosure.
evidence_prompt: Test the confidential request and response process.

criterion: House rules cover guests, noise, substances and shared spaces.
rationale: Common expectations reduce avoidable conflict in a live-work house.
evidence_prompt: Review the cohort-specific house rules before acceptance.

criterion: Conflict, harassment and removal procedures are defined.
rationale: A community promise needs a safe route for complaints and proportionate action.
evidence_prompt: Record reporter options, decision owner and consequences.

criterion: Photography and public-content participation require separate agreement.
rationale: Joining a residency is not consent to marketing or documentary content.
evidence_prompt: Review release wording and the opt-out path.

criterion: Confidential projects and intellectual property remain under participant control.
rationale: Proximity should not force disclosure or transfer of project rights.
evidence_prompt: Review confidentiality and intellectual-property clauses.

criterion: The expected work rhythm and mandatory activities are stated.
rationale: A participant cannot assess fit without knowing the balance of focus and group time.
evidence_prompt: Record mandatory sessions, quiet hours and uninterrupted blocks.

criterion: Each participant controls their project and milestone.
rationale: Selection should not imply employment, investment or transfer of decision rights.
evidence_prompt: Review the agreement and milestone process.

criterion: Selection criteria and conflicts of interest are described.
rationale: Applicants should understand what is assessed and whether sponsors influence selection.
evidence_prompt: Record criteria, reviewers and material relationships.

criterion: Testimonials identify the cohort and have publication permission.
rationale: A quote without context or consent cannot establish a repeatable outcome.
evidence_prompt: Verify the speaker, cohort, approved wording and date.

criterion: Launch, revenue, funding and partnership claims link to a verifiable record.
rationale: Residency association should not be confused with causation or endorsement.
evidence_prompt: Request the public artifact and participant-approved attribution.

criterion: Outcomes state starting point, time horizon and limitations.
rationale: Without a baseline and timeframe, progress claims are easy to overread.
evidence_prompt: Record milestone, observed deliverable, later result and external factors.

criterion: Unresolved questions are listed before payment or travel.
rationale: A visible open-questions list prevents enthusiasm from becoming assumed fact.
evidence_prompt: Publish or retain a dated decision log with owner and due date.
